images.title: Fold 26 and fold 30 against real heights
images.purpose: Compares the stack after 26 folds (about 670 m) with the 830 m Burj Khalifa, and after 30 folds (about 10.7 km) with the 11 km depth of the Mariana Trench.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One vertical scale with two tall bars and two horizontal dashed reference lines.
images.exact_structure: A vertical axis line in dark outline on the left, from 0 at the bottom to 12 km at the top, with no numbers on it except 0. Two teal (#0072B2) vertical bars stand on the baseline: a short bar reaching about one eighteenth of the axis height, labelled fold 26: 670 m above it, and a tall bar reaching about nine tenths of the axis height, labelled fold 30: 10.7 km above it. One short amber (#E69F00) dashed horizontal line just above the top of the short bar, at about one fifteenth of the axis height, labelled Burj Khalifa 830 m at its left end, away from the bar label. One reddish purple (#CC79A7) dashed horizontal line just above the tall bar, at eleven twelfths of the axis height, labelled Mariana Trench 11 km at its left end. Exactly 2 bars and 2 dashed lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Only four more doublings take the stack from building height to the depth of the deepest ocean.

images.context: 0.001 cm × 2 to the power 26 is about 671 m; × 2 to the power 30 is about 10.74 km.

image_decisions.why: Two landmark heights beside two fold bars make the speed of doubling visible at a glance.
